Built **RIFT RUMBLE**, a playable pixel-art Sonic vs. Shadow fighting game.

- Choose Sonic or Shadow, then fight the other as a CPU rival.
- Move, jump, use spin attacks and boost dashes, and transform when your Chaos Meter is full.
- Includes health and meter HUDs, a round timer, hit effects, sound toggle, rematches, and touch controls for mobile.

To play, open `index.html` or serve the project with a local web server. I checked the game in a browser on desktop and a mobile-sized viewport.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable pixel-art fighting game featuring only Sonic and Shadow.

## Requirements
- Use only Sonic and Shadow as playable/rival characters.
- Include pixel-style presentation.
- Include character selection, transformations, and fighting moves such as spin attacks.
- Support desktop controls and responsive mobile touch controls.
- Build and verify a complete playable experience.

## Decisions
- Created “RIFT RUMBLE” with an arcade UI and a player-versus-CPU format.
- The player may choose Sonic or Shadow; the rival is the alternate character.
- Implemented transformed forms using a fully charged Chaos Meter.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the full HTML/CSS game interface and responsive layouts.
- Implemented character selection, movement, jumping, spin attacks, boost dashes, transformations, health, meter, timer, CPU behavior, effects, sound, rematches, and mobile controls.
- Added a custom favicon and verified the game with desktop and mobile-sized browser screenshots.
- Confirmed `game.js` passes `node --check game.js`.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Continue with follow-up feature requests or visual refinements; no immediate fixes are known.

## Relevant Files
- `[index.html]`: Main game page and interface markup.
- `[style.css]`: Pixel-art styling, responsive layout, HUD, and touch controls.
- `[game.js]`: Gameplay, canvas rendering, controls, CPU, combat, transformations, and effects.

## Important Context
- The browser verification used `http://localhost:3002`.
- Desktop controls are arrow keys or A/D for movement, Up/W/Space for jump, J/Z for spin attack, K/X for boost, and L/C for transformation.
- The implementation is uncommitted and is limited to the three relevant game files.
